    component_sizes = [len(c) for c in components]
    odd_size_components = [i for i, size in enumerate(component_sizes) if size % 2 == 1]
    even_size_components = [i for i, size in enumerate(component_sizes) if size % 2 == 0]

    if len(odd_size_components) >= 2:
        w += len(odd_size_components) * (len(odd_size_components) - 1) // 2
    if len(even_size_components) >= 1 and len(odd_size_components) >= 1:
        w += len(even_size_components) * len(odd_size_components)

    if w > 0:
        print("1", w)
        return

    # Count the number of ways to choose 3 vertices in a component of size >= 3
    # and they are not all connected yet
    w = 0

            w += count

    if w > 0:
        print("2", w)
        return

        print("3 1")
